recorderBrands.label: Hikvision / Prama / HiLook
recorderBrands.notes: Channel 3 main stream is /Streaming/Channels/301, sub stream 302. RTSP is on by default (Configuration › Network › Advanced Settings › Integration Protocol for ONVIF). Use H.264 under Configuration › Video › Video Type / Encoding.

recorderBrands.label: CP Plus
recorderBrands.notes: Dahua-based. Main stream subtype=0, sub stream subtype=1. Check Main Menu › Network › Connection › RTSP port (554) and set the channel to H.264 under Encode.

recorderBrands.label: Dahua
recorderBrands.notes: Main stream subtype=0, sub stream subtype=1. RTSP port is under Setting › Network › Port.

recorderBrands.label: Uniview
recorderBrands.notes: Main stream s0, sub stream s1.

recorderBrands.label: Godrej
recorderBrands.notes: Most Godrej recorders use the Dahua-style realmonitor URL.

recorderBrands.label: Honeywell
recorderBrands.notes: Honeywell Performance-series recorders use the Dahua-style realmonitor URL.

recorderBrands.label: Other (ONVIF)
recorderBrands.notes: The store AI box asks the recorder for the stream URL over ONVIF (GetStreamUri on the HTTP port). The template is only a fallback. Enable ONVIF and create an ONVIF user on the recorder.

recorderBrands.label: Custom URL pattern
recorderBrands.notes: Type the URL pattern yourself. It must start with rtsp:// and contain {channel}; you can also use {user}, {pass}, {host} and {port}.
